Posters question Congress leader Kamal Nath's absence in Chhindwara

Political posters questioning the absence of former Madhya Pradesh Chief Minister Kamal Nath have appeared in Chhindwara. The posters have sparked political discussion and accusations regarding local issues in the region. The incident has intensified political activity in the area.
